_README: THE LEDGER — the single source of truth for every fact this project quotes.
Rule: prose cites the ledger; the ledger never cites prose. If a number, a status
label, or a constant appears in a Markdown file, it must agree with this file, and
tools/ledger_check.py enforces that. This exists because the project has already
shipped four different assertion counts across five documents.
Fields marked GENERATED are derived from docs/TEST_OUTPUT.txt by tools/ledger_sync.py.
Never hand-edit them; re-run the sync after capturing a test run.
Everything else is hand-maintained and should change only via a DECISIONS.md entry.

tests._GENERATED: by tools/ledger_sync.py from docs/TEST_OUTPUT.txt — do not hand-edit

determinism._note: interpreters_swept must cover interpreters_required or the claim is scoped down to what was swept. RAISED to five versions on 2026-07-25 (D-010). SEPARATELY, D-012 records that seed-sweeping ALONE cannot establish determinism for this substrate: iteration order derives from uuid4 values, which differ per process regardless of PYTHONHASHSEED. Determinism must be established by REMOVING order dependence, not by sweeping an axis that does not control it.

0a.name: substrate store
0a.note: DEMOTED 2026-07-25 (D-012). Integrity and purity unaffected. Determinism leg of Phase 0's done-means falsified by DEFECT-A: roads_from() yields from an unordered set of uuid4 ids, which is the enabling condition. Returns to PROVEN on fix + re-verification.

0b.name: spreading activation
0b.note: DEMOTED 2026-07-25 (D-012). DEFECT-A: convergent accumulation is a naive sequential float add over uuid4-ordered terms; 48 fresh processes gave two results at library defaults on a 5-node graph. Returns to PROVEN on fix + re-verification.

0b1.name: coalition strength determinism fix
0b1.note: math.fsum at both sites; 40/40 identical at fixed seed on 3.10 where it was 20/10. See BUG-0b1. AMENDED 2026-07-25: correct at its own site, but its INPUTS are 1-ULP-unstable across processes on in-degree >= 3 graphs (DEFECT-A on 0b), so an order-independent sum of order-dependent terms is still order-dependent. BUG-0b1 section 5's 'Tier 1 is not affected' sentence is retracted in place. CORRECTED 2026-07-26 (D-014): the report's 'two sites' was WRONG — there are three Coalition construction sites in src/ (nous_coalitions.py:228, :311, and nous_workspace.py:426) and the third was never converted, so the bug was reported closed while a live instance remained on the same competition path. Corrected in place in docs/BUG-0b1-*.md sections 2 and 9, which also now explain the 3.11-vs-3.12 split: CPython 3.12 made builtin sum() Neumaier-compensated, so the pre-fix code was accidentally correct on newer interpreters. The third site converts in 0c. WHETHER 0b1 KEEPS 'PROVEN' GIVEN ITS COMPLETENESS CLAIM WAS FALSE IS AN OPEN CALL FOR CAGAN — not re-labelled here on an agent's initiative.

0b2.name: conserved activation (overlay, default-off)
0b2.note: overlay landed default-off; tester verdict FAIL — 7 of 9 invariants hold. DEFECT-B (N-5) and DEFECT-C (N-7) are the overlay's own and are OPEN. See D-011, D-012.

0c.name: deterministic road ordering
0c.note: SPEC-0c. Repair brick for the three defects the 0b2 tester pass returned (D-011). Ordering AND math.fsum both land (D-013): _out/_in become insertion-ordered so roads_from() yields creation order, and the convergence accumulator uses math.fsum, so the engine is order-INDEPENDENT rather than merely order-pinned. Also: read each road once per expansion (DEFECT-B), validate sigma and guard non-finite transmission (DEFECT-C). D-014 CLOSES the last open call and WIDENS scope: all three surviving naive float sum() sites in src/ convert, because nous_workspace.py:426 is a LIVE instance of the defect BUG-0b1 was reported to have closed — reproduced post-0c at a FIXED hash seed, 2 distinct strengths on 3.10 and 1 on 3.14 (the Neumaier split). SPEC-0c section 1 now carries a SECOND reproduction case on the competition path, asserted by O-4b; the original falsifier exercised only the activation accumulator and would have let this ship. Acceptance signal is inverted: all six asserted-negatives in tests/test_tester_0b2_adversarial.py must go RED, plus four further tests the spec now enumerates. Returns 0a and 0b to PROVEN on tester re-verification.

0d.name: float-accumulation detector
0d.note: SPEC-0d. Deliverable is a DETECTOR, not a patch: a structural check (ledger_check C6) enumerating every float accumulation in src/ and requiring each to be math.fsum or registered in ledger.float_accumulation_exemptions with a reason, failing the build when a new naive one appears. THEN fixes what it finds: nous_field.py:131 (confirmed — 2 bit patterns over source-order permutations, reaching Coalition.strength) and nous_field.py:124 / merged_flow (SAME SHAPE, did NOT reproduce on a four-way-convergence probe — converted on shape, not on a witness). Rationale: all three prior encounters of this shape (BUG-0b1's two sites, SPEC-0c section 2.5's third, section 2.7's fourth) were found BY LOOKING, never by a sweep, and twice the survivor sat in a file the previous fix's author had open. Both known sites are ORDER-PINNED, so 0d is hardening, NOT a determinism repair, and does not block Phase 0's re-labelling.
